verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say users can "describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you" [docs-18]. The built-in MCP server lets AI assistants build flows through natural language [docs-4, docs-27]. Changelog entries show prompt-to-agent drafting [docs-8] and prompt-driven editing of an agent's instructions and tools [docs-29]. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of generating or editing flows (not just agents) directly in the builder from a prompt, explicit evidence of natural-language editing of existing flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
